review.gallery: One dated OMNIYAT construction photo and nine project-specific renders from its original brochure.
review.location: OMNIYAT provides the ENARA marker and the Marasi Bay brochure locator. The brochure’s time rings do not assign exact times to each destination. Nearby drive times use the separate attributed Obaco Homes ENARA estimates.
review.floorPlans: Five complete OMNIYAT office test fits. The newer brochure visually confirms the 676 and 950 sq m simplex examples. The Sales N Lease booklet also includes all three triplex levels and marks the figures as usable area excluding toilets and IT rooms. These are sample office arrangements, distinct from marketed office areas that include other space. No inventory claim is derived from the older unit-mix diagram.

unavailable: Verified visitor entrance, finished-building photography and complete current unit-specific lease or sale drawings.
